title: Gate alpha evidence on readiness state
summary: Alpha release evidence should carry the repository readiness report so draft bundles expose blockers and accepted bundles cannot ignore unresolved release gates.
expectedFailureModes: Accepted release bundles omit unresolved alpha readiness blockers.
Draft evidence cannot be generated from a dirty or commit-blocked checkout for handoff review.
Bundle validation accepts malformed readiness JSON or local machine identifiers.
humanEscalation: Human approval is still required before creating tags, publishing artifacts, or overriding release blockers.
nextAction: Embed alpha-release-readiness output in alpha release evidence, teach bundle validation to reject blocked accepted evidence, and document the draft override.
